mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to collagen was most worthwhile because the contrast showed how the two materials contribute to bone strength.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells to the framework felt more like assembling a cutaway than discovering how bone develops, although the picture showed where the cells belong.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some bone-matrix-producing cells become embedded in the matrix as osteocytes.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals generally made the pairings clear.

continue.text: I would continue: seeing how the cartilage, fluid and ligaments contribute different things to the elbow made me curious about how muscles would move it.
